## (2) Hazards / smells noticed, not investigated (out of scope)
1. Two DSFlash instances ran concurrently this session (T205 and T207 both agent=DSFlash); T206/T207/T208 done-transitions sat uncommitted in tasks.json until I bundled them into my kanban commit. Anyone running git add -A mid-session absorbs another worker's kanban transitions or doc edits. The documented 'two Fable sessions share one git index' gotcha generalizes to every worker; nothing enforces it.
2. T205's brief and the roadmap's T207 row both claimed INDEX.md (brief: 'docs/INDEX.md belongs to THIS task (not T207)' vs roadmap Phase-2 table: 'INDEX.md routing' under T207). Resolved only by the brief's explicit override; T207 landed without touching INDEX.md. Latent scoping overlap for future parallel doc tasks.
3. CURRENT.md internally contradicted itself before my edit: the Concurrency section said the ADR-0020 amendment was 'drafted, uncommitted, do not commit or revert it' while the Resolved section said 'committed 0c3c3ac'. Stale-concurrency-sweep hazard; I fixed the concurrency lines, did not investigate how the contradiction arose (likely two refreshes racing).
4. The 'PROPOSED specs awaiting their spec gate' section (orcha-tools, argus, project-restructure) was left as history inside the superseded block; I did not verify those gate statuses. T219 now examines orcha-tools and argus bookends.
5. Spec-vs-actual artifact location drift: oracle-v2 spec section 4 names data/oracle-{goban}-v2.wzo2 but the artifact lives in untracked/oracle-v2/. Any tool or reader resolving spec paths will miss it; the artifact is git-ignored so a fresh clone lacks it (recorded in SHA256SUMS only).
6. Sprint phase lettering P3-A..P3-H is non-monotonic in task numbers (T186 = P3-H i5-calibrate, T187 = P3-G battery run; T193 = P3-F M4a run). I did not map the full phase-to-task lettering; commit messages are the only trace, and the letter sequence is not derivable from task order.
